summary: Defines a set of managed objects, in the Management Information Base used by SNMP, for monitoring and managing MAC bridges that follow the IEEE 802.1D standard and link LAN segments together. It was replaced by RFC 4188.

eli5.summary: A bridge joins two small networks. This memo gives a list of dials and gauges, so a manager can check on a bridge from far away.

questions: how to manage 802.1d bridges with snmp
